'''Sylvet Depp''' was the brother of [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Orun Depp]]. Sylvet worked as a clerk in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Zygian's Banking Concern (Mos Eisley)|branch]] of [[Zygian Savings and Loan]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG7" />
